lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Capitol Hill, 2031. A full public gallery, a floor with forty members on it out of six hundred, and a private member's bill at its third reading.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: The Enabling Bill. Eleven pages. It creates a legal category: perpetual administrative counterparty.

lines.speaker: wren
lines.text: That means nothing to me and I can tell from your face that it should.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: It means a thing can have an owner forever. Not a company, not a person, not a term of years. Forever. Everything I have been chasing hangs off this room, this afternoon.

lines.speaker: mara
lines.text: Eleven pages and a third reading on a Thursday. This is exactly how it is always done and I have never once been able to prove it.
